# statuspage_page_access_group (Resource)

Manages a Statuspage page access group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = statuspage_page_access_group.engineering
  id = "abc123def456/page-access-group-id-1"
}

resource "statuspage_page_access_group" "engineering" {
  page_id              = "abc123def456"
  name                 = "Engineering Team"
  external_identifier  = "eng-team"
  component_ids        = [statuspage_component.api.id]
  metric_ids           = [statuspage_metric.response_time.id]
  page_access_user_ids = [statuspage_page_access_user.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `page_id` (String)

### Optional

- `component_ids` (List of String)
- `external_identifier` (String)
- `metric_ids` (List of String)
- `page_access_user_ids` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
